name: project-praxis
description: Project Praxis — constitutional docs + implementation repository

scripts.lint:ds: pnpm lint:ds:colors && pnpm lint:ds:spacing && pnpm lint:ds:paddings
scripts.preinstall: node -e "const userAgent = process.env.npm_config_user_agent || ''; const execPath = process.env.npm_execpath || ''; if (!userAgent.startsWith('pnpm/') && !execPath.includes('pnpm')) { console.error('ERROR: This repository uses pnpm only. Run: pnpm install'); process.exit(1); }"
scripts.supabase:types: mkdir -p packages/supabase/src && supabase --workdir supabase gen types --local --lang typescript > packages/supabase/src/database.types.ts
scripts.supabase:types:linked: mkdir -p packages/supabase/src && supabase --workdir supabase gen types --linked --lang typescript > packages/supabase/src/database.types.ts
scripts.test:e2e:axe: CI_WEB_SERVER_COMMAND='pnpm --filter @praxis/planner dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4173' playwright test tests/a11y/inbox-today.a11y.spec.ts --grep 'axe scan'
scripts.test:e2e:keyboard: CI_WEB_SERVER_COMMAND='pnpm --filter @praxis/planner dev --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 4173' playwright test tests/a11y/inbox-today.a11y.spec.ts --grep 'keyboard focus'
